title.en: An Act Declaring January 23 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Province of Bulacan in Commemoration of the Inauguration of the Philippine Republic

text.en: January 23 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Province of Bulacan in commemoration of the inauguration of the Philippine Republic. Upon proclamation of the President, January 23 of every year shall be a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Bulacan.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
